      Undoes the effect of the [Start Modifying Voice Lines](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/start%2Bmodifying%2Bvoice%2Blines) action for one or more Players.
      
### Arguments

  **Description**: The Player or Players whose movement collision is affected.
